title: Adaptive World-Models for Anomaly Recognition (AWARE): A Framework for Robot Dynamics Prediction and Introspection
abstract: arXiv:2610.32742v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Unrecognized anomalies in critical infrastructure can rapidly cascade into catastrophic physical or operational failures. Current anomaly detection approaches often rely on direct access to the monitored system by utilizing onboard sensors, such as motor encoders, to detect anomalous states. However, legacy hardware often lacks these sensors, or strict security protocols may prohibit access altogether. We therefore present AWARE, a world model framework that is capable of anomaly detection using only external camera monitoring via system dynamics estimation and state prediction. Evaluated across 240 real-world robotic crane trajectories, including payload collisions and motor degradations, AWARE demonstrates a 26% improvement in anomaly classification over our strongest baseline under noisy, camera-only state estimation. translated_title: 自适应世界模型异常识别（AWARE）：机器人动力学预测与自省框架
translated_abstract: 关键基础设施中未被识别的异常可能迅速演变为灾难性的物理或运营故障。当前的异常检测方法通常依赖于直接访问被监控系统，利用机载传感器（如电机编码器）来检测异常状态。然而，老旧硬件往往缺乏这些传感器，或者严格的安全协议可能完全禁止访问。因此，我们提出了AWARE——一个世界模型框架，仅通过外部摄像头监控，结合系统动力学估计与状态预测即可实现异常检测。在包含负载碰撞和电机退化的240条真实世界机器人起重机轨迹上的评估表明，在嘈杂的仅摄像头状态估计条件下，AWARE的异常分类性能较最强基线提升了26%。此外，推断出的动力学参数可被解码以识别故障来源，定位性能退化……
tldr: AWARE是一个仅依靠外部摄像头监控即可实现机器人异常检测的世界模型框架，通过系统动力学估计与状态预测，在真实起重机数据上异常分类性能比最强基线提升26%，并能解码动力学参数定位故障来源。
en_tdlr: AWARE is a world-model framework that enables anomaly detection using only external camera monitoring through system dynamics estimation and state prediction, achieving a 26% improvement in anomaly classification over the strongest baseline on real-world crane data while decoding dynamics parameters to localize fault sources.
